_about: Cincinnatus, 458 BC: the framework's sample game (the second-game slice of Ronin job fw-F6, 29 Oct 2026; moved here in job fw-F5). `npx eraforge build` in the framework checkout builds it into sample-game/pub_cincinnatus/ with the framework's own pages; the release gate (README) plays it through. The engine files are core/ + systems/ + the kits named here; the game's own code is src/*.js (people, progression, enemies and story are registered content) and its processed art assets/game/. Design rules: charter.md. It builds on the framework's plain theme (a Roman theme is a game job: gap G18).
